title: SELL ALL FROM THE ITEM MENU
why: His answer 24 (2026-10-12): selling is right-click and choose SELL. Right-clicking an item on the Stash screen (Y on a controller) already offered Sell one; a stack now also offers Sell all with the total price on the row, so a pile of salvage goes in one choice instead of one click per copy. It pays the same as selling them one at a time, in credits and in XP. Copies packed in your backpack stay packed.
now: Right-click a stack in the stash and choose Sell all to sell the whole stack at once.
